arguments.content: P1 pattern: delayed cleanup keyed only by a shared resource can delete a newer operation's state even when operations are fully serialized. A failed operation's queued cleanup must remove only state still owned by that operation; absence checks alone do not protect a replacement owner. Review the complete sequence failed operation -> replacement completes -> old cleanup -> unchanged state consumer, plus own-state cleanup and repeated cleanup. Existing happy-path/own-cleanup tests can pass while this sequence regresses. Preserve an operation/owner identity guard; serialization does not eliminate stale lifecycle work.
